aeRules: TDRA v3 annexes 1/2: B is limited to 144–146 MHz, 50 W PEP. A65 does not determine A/B class. Check individual authorisation and suffix conditions.
arabicVoiceNote: Kareem: Jordanian Arabic, one speaker. Text stays on this device.
bandConditions: Reference only: source footnotes, licence and local conditions apply.
bandMatch: Matches a listed reference range; read the conditions
bandUnlisted: Class/frequency not in the selected table. Transmission eligibility is unverified; check the official source.
callOfflineNote: Recognition uses format and prefix only; it does not verify assignment, ownership or licence validity. Check the class against your licence.
converterHint: Convert between text and Morse code.
creditsLicenseNote: Engines and voice models have separate licenses; each source retains its own license.
deRules: AFuV classes A/E/N are assessed separately. N uses ERP; other rows use the stated PEP limits. Check site, antenna and EMF conditions in the source.
decoderAmbiguous: Speed is ambiguous because the marks have similar lengths. Set the known speed to distinguish dots from dashes.
decoderCaptureError: Could not record. Check the selected input, Windows microphone permissions and whether another app is using it.
decoderCaptureHint: Choose an input, then record. Stop to decode; recording stops automatically after 30 seconds. The temporary audio is deleted afterwards. Sound-card inputs appear here when Windows exposes them; this does not control a radio.
decoderDuration: The recording exceeds 120 seconds. Trim it first.
decoderFileSize: Choose a WAV file smaller than 64 MB.
decoderFormat: Unsupported or damaged WAV. Use mono/stereo PCM (8/16/24/32-bit) or IEEE float (32/64-bit), 8–192 kHz.
decoderHint: Decode a clean, single-tone Morse recording offline. WAV: up to 120 seconds / 64 MB, mono or stereo PCM / float. Voice and overlapping stations are not supported. □ marks uncertain characters.
decoderNoDevice: No audio input found. Connect a microphone or enable an input in Windows.
decoderNoSignal: No audible signal found. Check the recording and input volume.
decoderNoTone: No clear Morse tone found between 200 and 2000 Hz. Try a clean, single-tone recording.
decoderNotMorse: The signal does not have recognisable Morse timing. Check the tone, threshold and speed.
decoderPermission: Microphone access was denied. Allow desktop microphone access in Windows privacy settings.
decoderThresholdHint: Raise the threshold to ignore noise; lower it for weaker signals. For single-length marks, set the known speed manually.
decoderWindowsCapture: Audio-input recording is currently available in the Windows version. WAV-file decoding works here.
fileError: File conversion failed. Check UTF-8 encoding, the 8 MiB limit and an unused output name.
fileLimit: UTF-8 .txt files · Up to 8 MiB each · Existing files are never replaced.
fixedCallNote: Registered call; check location and licence.
gbRules: OFW611 Schedule 1 tables A/B/C. Ground stations only; airborne and coordination exceptions are excluded. Suffixes may be optional; check the regional letter rule for Intermediate calls starting with 2.
glossaryHint: Short definitions, examples and Morse audio. Prosigns such as <AR> are sent without a gap between letters.
guide.empty: No ranges are listed for this country and class. This does not mean transmission is prohibited; check the official source.
guide.intro: Each card shows a frequency interval. Read the power limit and special conditions together; one band may have several intervals.
guide.scale: Each line shows only its own card's interval; cards do not share a common scale.
guide.scope: These are selected CW references, not permission to transmit. Check your licence and the country conditions separately.
guide.title: CW bands and power limits
invalidMorse: Check the Morse code and word separator.
keyingBalanced: Dots, dashes and gaps match the target rhythm.
keyingDashLong: Dashes are too long; a dash should last three dots.
keyingDashShort: Dashes are too short; a dash should last three dots.
keyingDotLong: Dots are longer than the target; release sooner.
keyingDotShort: Dots are shorter than the target; hold slightly longer.
keyingElementGapLong: Elements within a letter are too far apart; wait one dot.
keyingElementGapShort: Elements within a letter are too close; wait one dot.
keyingIgnoredTaps: Inputs shorter than 5 ms were ignored.
keyingInterrupted: An unfinished press was discarded. Losing focus or holding for over 10 seconds releases the key.
keyingIntroduction: Send Morse yourself and measure your timing and spacing.
keyingKeyboardHelp: Click this key, then hold and release Space. You can also use a mouse or touch. Space works normally in text fields.
keyingLetterGapLong: Letter gaps are too long; leave a three-dot gap.
keyingLetterGapShort: Letters are too close; leave a three-dot gap.
keyingLimit: This attempt reached the 4096-mark limit. Start a new attempt.
keyingMeasurementNote: Decoding uses your target speed; incorrect timing may produce a different letter. Effective speed is the PARIS equivalent of marks and gaps between the first press and last release. Waiting after the attempt is excluded. Each new attempt replaces the previous result.
keyingSoundUnavailable: The key tone is unavailable. Visual keying and timing still work.
keyingUneven: Average durations are close, but individual presses vary. Keep an even rhythm.
keyingUnrecognized: This mark sequence is not recognized in the selected alphabet (�). Check the elements and letter gaps.
keyingWordGapLong: Word gaps are too long; leave a seven-dot gap.
keyingWordGapShort: Words are too close; leave a seven-dot gap.
logHint: Shows the latest 50 records; export includes all records of the selected type. Practice and real contacts are separate. ADIF contains basic ASCII contact fields; CSV preserves all notes.
logbook.browseHint: Records are shown in pages of 25. Practice and actual contacts stay separate. CSV includes all notes; ADIF includes supported CW fields.
logbook.dateHint: Date format: YYYY-MM-DD. Blank dates have no limit; the start must not be later than the end.
logbook.duplicateHint: Duplicates must match UTC time and its stated precision, both callsigns, exact frequency (or band when frequency is absent) and record type. Different seconds or frequencies remain separate. Source practice/actual markers are preserved.
logbook.editInvalid: Check callsigns, UTC time, CW reports, band/frequency and location. Use a decimal point; latitude and longitude must be supplied together.
logbook.exportAll: Exports contain all records of the selected type, without search filters.
logbook.fallbackCall: Your callsign if missing from the file
logbook.importHint: ASCII .adi/.adif files with CW contacts are supported (up to 8 MB / 10,000 records). Review the summary before adding anything. The source file stays untouched. Extra fields may be omitted; this logbook is not a complete backup of the original file.
logbook.importInvalid: The file could not be read or its ADIF structure is unsupported. Check ASCII encoding, field lengths and EOH/EOR markers. No records were added.
logbook.locationHint: Example: KN40. Only supplied locations appear on the map. A locator marks a cell centre, not an exact address. You can also enter latitude and longitude together when editing, using a decimal point.
logbook.mapCredit: Map: Natural Earth · Public domain · Simplified coastlines
logbook.mapHint: Shows the newest 500 supplied locations from all matching results. Callsigns are never geolocated; no internet connection is used. This equirectangular map does not show borders or operating permissions.
logbook.unmarked: When the file has no practice/actual marker
manualCallReview: Full call confirmed by the user; authorisation and assignment not verified.
nativeUnavailable: The conversion engine could not be loaded. Reinstall the app package.
normalizationNote: Latin: Turkish letters are simplified. Russian: Ё → Е. Arabic: marks and tatweel are omitted; hamza carriers, ى and ة are normalized. Decoding cannot restore the original spelling.
otherRules: No built-in rules for this country. Verify local permissions and call rules manually; the app does not infer transmission privileges.
portableCallNote: Suggested domestic suffix; verify licence conditions.
portableCallReview: Confirm and enter the full call under this country's operating rules.
practiceNote: Up to 10 questions. Review mistakes in a separate round. Example call signs are for practice.
qsoAssistantHint: Choose a contact step, prepare the message and listen in Morse. QSO means a radio contact; the app does not transmit over radio.
qsoLogHint: Find, edit or map your saved contacts. Practice and actual contacts are kept separate.
qsoProcedureNote: Listen first, check the frequency and wait for a reply. Prepared text is a CW template; every message includes your call. No radio connection or automatic transmission.
qsoRecordDetails: Add this contact to the log
question: Question
radioDataError: Radio data could not be read. Existing files are preserved; back up and inspect before changing them.
radioLocal: Call signs, CW preparation and local logs. This version does not connect to a radio or transmit RF.
rstHint: CW report: readability 1–5, strength 1–9, tone 1–9. Enter the report you actually observed.
ruRules: SRR's GKRCh references were reviewed; the current official power annex was inaccessible. Automatic frequency/power matching is disabled for this profile. Verify category and operating call against your licence.
rulesCoverage: Selected CW ranges; not a complete rule set or transmission authorisation. Upper edge excluded. Keep the whole signal inside the band; check licence, local conditions and band plan separately.
saRules: CST RR55 (2025), annexes 19-1 and 20. The reversed 80 m limits printed in the English document are omitted, not guessed. Class 2 shows only explicitly listed microwave ranges; your licensed frequencies govern.
selectClass: Select the class on your licence
settingsRecovered: Preferences could not be read; defaults are in use.
speechError: Speech generation failed. Check the speech pack installation.
speechLimit: Speech is limited to 4000 characters at a time.
speechLocalNote: Text is processed on this device. Stop also cancels speech.
speechPackHelp: Install the pack once; speech works without internet. Models load only during synthesis. If you moved the pack, select its folder.
speechPackMissing: Offline speech pack missing. Select it in Settings → Speech pack.
speechUnavailable: Speech is not available on this platform yet.
stationCheck: Check country, class and call sign together.
stationProfilesHint: Save your call sign and licence details. This station will be used when preparing contacts.
stationRequired: Save a station and select its licence class first.
term_ar: End of message. A and R are sent as one sign.
term_as: Wait. A and S are sent as one sign.
term_cq: General call to any suitable station.
term_hh: Error sign: eight dots; correct the mistaken part.
term_k: Invitation to transmit; any station may reply.
term_kn: Reply invited from the addressed station only.
term_knProsign: Over to the addressed station only; K and N joined.
term_qrl: Is the frequency in use? Listen and wait for a reply.
term_qrv: Ready; with a question mark, are you ready?
term_qsl: Receipt acknowledgement; contact confirmation by context.
term_rst: Readability, signal strength and tone for CW.
term_sk: End of contact. S and K are sent as one sign.
thanksBody: Thank you to the developers of the open-source models and tools that make offline speech possible.
trHomebuilt: Class B: this HF exception requires home-built equipment of at most 5 W.
trRules: CW transmitter output limits are shown; do not confuse them with PEP values. Emergency priority and Table 25 footnotes apply. Area-change suffixes depend on notification requirements.
unknownCountry: Country not recognised in this catalog
unsupported: A character is not supported by the selected alphabet.
updateConfirm: Update verified. Confirm to open Setup. MorseCore will close; your files, settings and voice pack will be kept.
updateFailed: The update could not be downloaded or verified. Retry or download it from the release page.
updateUnavailable: Update check unavailable. You can continue offline.
usRules: Selected CW ranges from 47 CFR 97, ITU Region 2 only. Region 1/3 and 60 m exceptions excluded. A call sign does not determine licence class; select it from the licence.
uxDecoderIntro: Choose a WAV file or decode a microphone recording.
uxMorseIntro: Create audio from text or Morse code.
uxSpeechIntro: Enter text, choose a voice and listen.
uxStationStep: Enter your call sign, then check the country and licence class.
visitorCallReview: Visitor privileges are not assumed. Enter the locally authorised class and confirmed full call.
voicesArabicLicense: Kareem speaks Jordanian Arabic. Its source model card does not explicitly state the dataset license; review the source terms before redistributing this pack.
voicesCancelled: Operation cancelled. Verified files will be reused when you retry.
voicesDependencySize: The size shown covers the model and model card only. The shared runtime and dependencies need additional space; their download sizes vary. Remove voices you no longer need.
voicesFailed: The operation could not finish. Check your connection, free space and access to the speech folder, then retry. Setup logs are in its .voice-tools folder. Models changed outside the manager are preserved.
voicesInstallConsent: Download this voice and its required shared dependencies? Leaving this page cancels the download. The first installation may take several minutes because of the dependencies.
voicesIntro: Install a voice, listen to a short sample and choose it for speech. Downloads start only when you ask; text is then spoken on your device.
voicesLicenseApache: Code and model: Apache-2.0. License and acknowledgment files are kept in the voice pack.
voicesLicensePiper: Piper engine: GPL-3.0. Model terms are in its source card. The shared runtime runs as a separate process.
voicesLocationInvalid: The selected speech folder cannot be used. It may be a filesystem root, linked folder or restricted location. In Settings, choose a regular speech folder your user account can access.
voicesPhase_dependencies: Preparing shared speech components. The first installation may take several minutes…
voicesPhase_preview: Generating and playing the sample on your device…
voicesPhase_remove: Verifying and removing this voice's files…
voicesPhase_runtimeInstall: The official installer is running. Please wait for it to finish…
voicesRemoveConsent: Only verified model and model-card files for this voice are removed. Other voices, the shared runtime, your settings and recordings are kept.
voicesRemoved: Voice removed. The shared runtime is kept for other voices.
voicesRuntimeConsent: The official Python 3.13.16 runtime will be installed for this user. A compatible existing installation is reused. If the installer is unavailable locally, about 29 MiB is downloaded and its pinned SHA-256 checked. No administrator access or PATH change is requested. Once the official installer starts, wait for it to finish; the app's Cancel button cannot interrupt this stage.
voicesRuntimeMissing: The speech runtime was not found. On Windows, install it with the button below. Conversion and Morse audio do not need it.
voicesRuntimeReady: Speech runtime ready. Choose a voice to install.
voicesStopping: Waiting for the previous speech operation to finish. If the official installer has started, let it complete.
